mapper.select: select courseid,studenterId from common_course_timetable where studenterId = #{studenterId} and deleted = 0 and courseWeek = #{courseWeek} union select courseid,studenterId from common_course_plan where studenterId = #{studenterId} and planType = 0
call common_jhz_course(#{studenterId},#{courseId},#{plandt})
select count(id) from common_course_chapter where courseId =#{courseid}
select id from common_course where curriculum like #{courseName} and deleted =0 order by createdt desc
select id as subjectId,subjectName,deleted,ifuser from common_course_subject where deleted=0 and ifuser=1
select id from common_course where deleted=0 order by browse desc limit 30
select courseid from common_recommend a left join common_course b on a.courseid=b.id where a.ifuser=1 and a.deleted=0 and b.deleted=0 order by a.createdt desc limit 30
select id from common_course where deleted=0 order by createdt desc limit 30
select courseid from common_studyaid a left join common_course b on a.courseid=b.id where a.ifuser=1 and a.deleted=0 and b.deleted=0 order by a.createdt desc limit 30
select id,chaptername,knowledgeid as knowId from common_course_chapter where courseId=#{courseId} and deleted=0

select courseid from (select a.courseid,b.curriculum,b.author,b.synopsis,b.picture,b.browse,b.upvote,b.discussid,@rowNO:=@rowNO+1 AS billsort,'助学榜单' as bill from (SELECT @rowNO:=0)r , common_studyaid a left join common_course b on a.courseid=b.id where a.ifuser=1 and a.deleted=0 and b.deleted=0 order by a.createdt desc limit 10 ) g union all select courseid,curriculum,author,synopsis,picture,browse,upvote,discussid,bill,billsort from (select a.courseid,b.curriculum,b.author,b.synopsis,b.picture,b.browse,b.upvote,b.discussid,(@rowNO:=@rowNO+1) AS billsort,'推荐榜单' as bill from (SELECT @rowNO:=0)r , common_recommend a left join common_course b on a.courseid=b.id where a.ifuser=1 and a.deleted=0 and b.deleted=0 order by a.createdt desc limit 10) h union all select courseid,curriculum,author,synopsis,picture,browse,upvote,discussid,bill,billsort from (select id as courseid,author,curriculum,synopsis,picture,browse,upvote,discussid,(@rowNO:=@rowNO+1) AS billsort,'热门榜单' as bill from (SELECT @rowNO:=0)r , common_course where deleted=0 order by browse desc limit 10) j
call student_collect_course(#{courseId})

-- select a.discuss,a.studenterId,a.createdt,b.curriculum,a.courseid,(select count(*) FROM common_course_discuss_thumbs where discussid =a.id) as thumbs, -- (select nickname from sys_user where guid =(select studentuserid from common_student_user where studenterId =a.studenterId and deleted=0 limit 1) -- and ifuse=1 order by createdt limit 1) -- as nickname from common_course_discuss a left join common_course b on a.courseid=b.id where a.courseid=#{id}
select a.discuss,a.id,a.studenterId,a.createdt,b.curriculum,a.courseid,(select count(*) FROM common_course_discuss_thumbs where discussid =a.id and deleted=0) as thumbs, (select nickname from sys_user where guid =(select studentuserid from common_student_user where studenterId =a.studenterId and deleted=0 limit 1) and ifuse=1 order by createdt limit 1) as nickname from common_course_discuss a left join common_course b on a.courseid=b.id where a.courseid=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE common_course_discuss_thumbs SET deleted = #{deleted} WHERE id =#{thumbId}
mapper.select: select id as collectId from common_collect_course where deleted=0 and studenterid=#{studenterId} and courseid=#{courseId}
select noticecontent,noticetypename,createdt from common_course_notice where courseid =#{courseId} and deleted=0
select id as knowId,knowledgecontent as content from common_course_knowledge where id=#{id}
select courseid from sys_user_integral_record where studenterid =#{studenterId} and keyword='PURCHASECOURSE' and status =1
call student_collect_course (#{courseId})
select count(id) from common_course_discuss where courseid =#{id} and deleted =0

select count(courseId) as knowIdNumber,courseId,courseName,subjectId,picture from (select id as knowId,courseId,(select curriculum from common_course where id =courseId) as courseName,(select subjectid from common_course where id =courseId) as subjectId, (select picture from common_course where id =courseId) as picture from common_course_knowledge where courseId in (select courseid from common_course_purchase where studenterid=#{studenterId} and status=1)) as ko group by courseName

select count(knowId) AS knowIdNumber,courseId,courseName from ( select distinct a.knowledgeid as knowId,b.curriculum as courseName,a.courseid from common_lzmd_studyrate a LEFT JOIN common_course b on a.courseid =b.id where a.studenterid =#{studenterId} and a.isright=1) as ko group by courseid
select questiontype from common_course_questiontype where deleted=0

select.foreach: select * from (select t1.id as questionId,t1.knowledgeid as knowId,t1.title as question,t1.resolving,t1.rightaws as correctOption,t1.isgb,t1.schoolId,t1.subjectid from common_course_judge AS t1 JOIN ( select *from common_course_judge where knowledgeid in (select knowledgeContentId from common_course_knowledge WHERE id=#{item.knowId}) order by rand() limit 1) AS t2 WHERE t1.id >= t2.id ORDER BY t1.id LIMIT 1) as a1

select * from (select t1.id as questionId,t1.knowledgeid as knowId,t1.choicea as optionA,t1.choiceb as optionB,t1.choicec as optionC,t1.choiced optionD,t1.rightaws as correctOption,t1.resolving,t1.title as question,t1.isgb,t1.schoolId,t1.subjectid from common_course_multi AS t1 JOIN (select * from common_course_multi where knowledgeid in (select knowledgeContentId from common_course_knowledge WHERE id=#{item.knowId}) order by rand() limit 1) AS t2 WHERE t1.id >= t2.id ORDER BY t1.id LIMIT 1) as a1

select * from (select t1.id as questionId,t1.knowledgeid as knowId,t1.choicea as optionA,t1.choiceb as optionB,t1.choicec as optionC,t1.choiced as optionD,t1.rightaws as correctOption,t1.resolving, t1.title as question,t1.isgb,t1.schoolId,t1.subjectid from common_course_choice AS t1 JOIN (select * from common_course_choice where knowledgeid in (select knowledgeContentId from common_course_knowledge WHERE id=#{item.knowId}) order by rand() limit 1) AS t2 WHERE t1.id >= t2.id ORDER BY t1.id LIMIT 1) as a1

mapper.insert: insert into common_lzmd_studyrate(knowledgeid, startdt, enddt, userdt, createdt, answer, fillAnswer, questiontype, courseid, studenterId, knowledgeidiscompleted, questionId, isright) values (#{knowId},#{startdt},#{enddt},#{userdt},now(),#{answer},#{fillAnswer},#{questionType},#{courseId},#{studenterId},#{knowledgeidiscompleted},#{questionId},#{isright})
mapper.select: select id from common_course_knowledge where courseId=#{courseId} and isdelete=0
select distinct a.knowledgeid as knowId from common_lzmd_studyrate a LEFT JOIN common_course b on a.courseid =b.id where a.studenterid =#{studenterId} and a.isright=1 and courseid=#{courseId}
SELECT questionId from common_knowledge_question where courseId=#{courseId} and knowledgeId =#{knowledgeId} AND questionType=1 and isDelete = 0 order by isRandom limit 2
select * from student_wrongChoice_Question where questionId = #{questionId} order by id desc limit 1;
